g.text: │ basic+ │ ai-review │ code_reviewer role │ - │ yes │ findings │
none: the task's own test command only (no gate)
basic: lint/format, full test suite, AI code review
medium: + secret scan, SAST, dependency audit, coverage >= 60%
production: + type check, coverage >= 80%, licences, security checklist; major security findings block
scalable: + performance/scalability review, container/IaC scans, threat model; major performance findings
